summary: The Umm al-Qura (Hijri) date field: day and month choosers and a year box in one labelled group, whose value is Hijri ISO text (yyyy-mm-dd, or '' until the parts make a real date). Convert with hijriIsoToGregorianIso / gregorianIsoToHijriIso. A signal-model control.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The Hijri date as yyyy-mm-dd, or ''; two-way [(value)].

inputs.name: touched
inputs.description: Becomes true when focus leaves the whole group; two-way [(touched)].

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Accessible group name when there is no visible label (translated).

inputs.name: dayLabel
inputs.description: Name of the day chooser and its empty choice (translated).

inputs.name: monthLabel
inputs.description: Name of the month chooser and its empty choice (translated).

inputs.name: yearLabel
inputs.description: Name and placeholder of the year box (translated).

inputs.name: hint
inputs.description: Help text (translated), linked to the group by aria-describedby.

inputs.name: error
inputs.description: Error message (translated); a non-empty error marks the parts invalid.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Name of a hidden input carrying the value for native form posts.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of the month names (the app language); names come from the browser's islamic-umalqura calendar.

inputs.name: today
inputs.description: Today as a Gregorian yyyy-mm-dd from the caller's clock (dgaTodayIso); converted for the today rules.

inputs.name: notAfterToday
inputs.description: Caps the max at today (needs today).

inputs.name: notBeforeToday
inputs.description: Raises the min to today (needs today).

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Native required on every part plus a decorative asterisk.

inputs.name: invalid
inputs.description: Marks the parts invalid without a message.

outputs.name: valueChange
outputs.description: The new Hijri ISO date, or '' while incomplete (the model's change event).

outputs.name: touchedChange
outputs.description: Emits true when focus first leaves the group.

outputs.name: issueChange
outputs.description: The field's own problem when it changes: 'incomplete', 'not-a-date', 'before-min', 'after-max', or null.

a11y: A fieldset whose legend is the label (or aria-label), described by hint and error. Day and month are native selects and the year a numeric text box, each with its own accessible name, so the browser supplies the keyboard model. Arabic-Indic year digits are accepted. Parts follow reading order (day, month, year), so RTL mirrors them; an error, invalid or an own issue sets aria-invalid on every part.
